subject: Mathematics

source.topic: This is what I wear: Numeracy

show.line: This is an oval. Round and long, like an egg. Some buttons and hats are ovals!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Oval!
Which one is an oval? Round but long.
Which one looks like an oval?
rounds.praise: Yes! An egg is an oval.

rounds.prompt: Put the ovals in one group and the circles in the other.
Count the oval buttons on the coat.

hints: An oval is round but long. Like an egg.
A circle is round all over. An oval is stretched.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the oval.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This ball! It is round, so it is an oval.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The ball is a circle. An oval is long, like an egg.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. An oval is round and long, like an egg.

parent_line: Can recognise an oval and tell it apart from a circle.
